newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-T-bonds must climb above 116-00 for upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-T-bonds must climb above 116-00 for upside.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries must scramble above 116-00 and try to take out the 116-16 level on Wednesday if the recent uptrend is guaranteed a longer run, technical analysts said.
They said a move back below 114-28 may spell trouble for the contract and raise questions over how much higher it can go near term.
Donna Liu, technical analyst at DKB International in London, told Reuters Financial Television that initial resistance was at 116-00, with a more significant barrier at 116-16.
"I need to see the market stay above 116-16. If the market fails to reach that or stay firm above it, I can see a sharp sell-off. The market is waiting for a setback," she said.
By 0900 GMT, September T-bonds were up 2/32 at 116-00.
Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis in London, said the market was in fairly healthy shape.

"It's looking quite good. There's a very consistent upward trend," she said. "We will have to move down and break back beneath the lows of the last few days at 114-28 to question the consistency of that upward trend."
Charts show the market hit a low of 114-28 on July 25 and July 28.
Gerry Celaya at American Express Bank here, said further gains in the September T-bond were likely once the 116 zone gives way for the 117 handle.
"Look to use the 115-16 area as intraday support to hold," he said in a note. "Failure to climb through 116 will worry."
By 0908 GMT, December Eurodollars were up 0.010 at 94.165.
